section_summary.extract_value: This abstract describes a single study investigating a model of positive body image with 249 college women. The study used path analysis to examine how body appreciation mediates the relationship between interpersonal/intrapersonal variables (caregiver eating messages, attachment, perfectionism) and outcomes (intuitive eating, depressive symptoms). Body appreciation was found to be a significant mediator, positively predicting intuitive eating but not depressive symptoms.
